notes: step-0 rollouts from iter01 OPD run; 34% correct zero-shot. base forgetting score from iter08.
iter01: OPD collapse — renderer mismatch (thinking teacher / instruct student).
iter02 step-0; 28% correct zero-shot.
iter02 endpoint after 10 OPD steps; 42% correct, peak 59% at step 8.
iter03: teacher zero-shot eval on 64 problems; 45.3% correct. Anchors vs_teacher_gap.
iter04: 30-step OPD plateau (last-10 mean correct 38.6%). Pure OPD does NOT exceed teacher. iter08 forgetting score 0.9125 = base (no forgetting).
iter05: RL MATCHED hparams. Catastrophic collapse to 0% by step 7. Last-10 mean=0%. iter08 forgetting=0.30 (catastrophic loss of IF — generates degenerate tokens).
iter06: TUNED RL (LR=1e-5, gs=8). Last-10 mean=45.6%. Step 28 peak 64.8%. iter08 forgetting=0.9125 = base (NO forgetting despite RL).

iter07: OPD warmstart then TUNED RL. Last-10 mean=55.3%, peak=74.2% at step 25. vs_teacher_gap +0.112. iter08 forgetting=0.9125 (no forgetting). STRONG Claim C support: exceeds teacher by ~10pp AND exceeds RL-from-scratch by ~10pp.

iter08: 16-prompt rule-based instruction-following eval across 4 trained checkpoints + base. Key result: only the collapsed matched-hparams RL run shows forgetting (0.30). Tuned RL preserves IF (0.9125). Refines Claim B: forgetting is tied to training instability, not RL-vs-OPD. OPD's value is robustness without hparam tuning, not catastrophic-forgetting prevention per se.

iter08: seed-2 replication of iter07. Same hparams (OPD warmstart from 43426da0, LR=1e-5 gs=8), seed=2. Last-10 mean correct=58.4% (vs iter07 55.3%); peak=75.8% at step 7 (vs iter07 74.2% at step 25); final=69.5%. CONFIRMS OPD-then-RL gain is not seed noise.

iter09: seed-2 of iter06 tuned RL (LR=1e-5, gs=8, no OPD warmstart). Last-10 mean correct=44.1% reward=0.386, peak=61.7% at step 1, final step 29=45.3%. vs iter06 seed=0 (45.6%): replicates. Seed-2 OPD-then-RL minus tuned-RL gap = 58.4% - 44.1% = +14.3pp (vs seed-0 gap +9.7pp). +10pp OPD-then-RL gain robust across seeds.

iter10: 60-step OPD-then-RL (LR=1e-5, gs=8, OPD warmstart from 43426da0). Per-decade mean correct: 45/54/56/61/71/71 — clear monotonic gain, stabilizing in last 20 steps. Last-10 mean=71.1%, peak=83.6% at step 45, final=60.2%. vs_teacher_gap +0.285. SHOWS 30-step iter07 (55.3%) was NOT the asymptote; doubling budget gives +16pp.

iter12: 60-step TUNED RL from scratch (LR=1e-5 gs=8, NO OPD warmstart). Per-decade mean correct: 36/40/44/50/54/63 — climbing monotonically, still rising in last decade. Last-10 mean=63.0%, peak=68.8% at step 44, final=64.1%. Apples-to-apples vs iter10 OPD-then-RL (71.1%): gap is +8.1pp in OPD's favor (vs +25pp unfair 30vs60 comparison). OPD warmstart's advantage shrinks but does NOT close at matched budget.
Probe: countdown-v2 = 6 sources, max_source=50, max_target=1000. Teacher correct 6.25% (<25% gate) — too hard, even teacher can't solve consistently. Discard env.
Probe: 5 sources, max_source=30, max_target=300. Teacher correct 15.6% (<25%) — borderline, prefer v2b.
Probe: countdown-v2b = 5 sources, max_source=25, max_target=200, max_tokens=1024. Teacher correct 31.25%. PASSES teacher gate (≥25%).
Probe: student zero-shot on v2b. correct 12.5%, format 12.5%. Borderline cold (gate ≤10%) but close. Selected v2b for full experiments.
Probe: 6 sources, max_source=25, max_target=200. Teacher 18.75% (<25%), student 15.6% — teacher gate failed AND student-teacher gap collapses.

iter14: tuned RL 30 steps on countdown-v2b (5 src, max_source=25, max_target=200, max_tokens=1024). Last-10 mean correct=32.4%, peak=46.1% at step 5, step-0=28.1% correct frac_all_bad=31%. ENV NOT COLD — RL has signal and learns. Probe at group_size=1 (12.5%) under-counted student capability vs group_size=8 (28%). Need harder env.

Re-probe of countdown-v2 (6src/max50/max_target1000) at TRAINING group_size=8. Student step-0: correct=17.2%, frac_all_bad=50%, frac_all_good=0%. Colder than v2b but not extreme; 50% of groups still have some signal.

iter15: tuned RL 30 steps on countdown-v2 (6src/max50/max_target1000 max_tokens=1024). Last-10 mean correct=16.5%, peak=23.4% at step 17, step-0=18.0%. frac_all_bad bouncing 25-80%. RL barely moves from step-0 floor — V2 IS COLD-START env. RL has too little signal to learn effectively.

iter16: 30-step OPD on countdown-v2 (cold env, 6src/max50/max_target1000). RAN 27/30 steps before hanging (Tinker API contention with parallel teacher-gen). Last-10 mean correct=12.4%. STRIKING: OPD on this cold env is WORSE than iter15 tuned-RL (16.5%) — when teacher itself is weak (~17% pass@8), OPD's KL signal can't lift the student. Teacher_kl=0.10. Periodic checkpoint at step 20 (c4700c17-...weights/000020) used for iter17.

iter17: OPD-warmstart-then-RL on countdown-v2 (load OPD step-20 ckpt, 30 steps tuned RL). Last-10 mean correct=9.1%, peak=32% step 17, trajectory declines after step 20. WORSE than both iter15 RL-only (16.5%) and iter16 OPD-only (12.4%). Cold-start env (frac_all_bad bouncing 30-75%) provides degenerate RL gradient that degrades the OPD warmstart instead of building on it. Inverts the v1 finding completely.
